title: Rethinking Fairness: An Interdisciplinary Survey of Critiques of Hegemonic ML Fairness Approaches
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion, faith, or religious bias. Its focus is on critiques of ML fairness from the perspectives of critical race theory, feminist studies, disability studies, and STS, with a primary emphasis on structural injustices related to race, gender, class, and colonialism.
